list.name: Application Entry and API Layer
list.description: Exposes the Flask dashboard and command-line entry points for patient explanation and SMPL mesh export workflows.

list.name: Digital Twin Service Layer
list.description: Implements Stage 3 simulation, Stage 4 explain-only graph assembly, and patient-specific SMPL twin generation.

list.name: Data and Machine Learning Layer
list.description: Defines the shared BRFSS schema and model helpers and runs reproducible training, evaluation, SHAP, and scenario research pipelines.

list.name: Browser UI Layer
list.description: Renders the Jinja dashboard and supplies responsive styling and interactive Cytoscape behavior for Stages 1-4.

list.name: Validation and Test Layer
list.description: Verifies Stage 4 graph completeness, patient-data boundaries, model evidence fidelity, idempotence, and Neo4j fallback behavior.

list.name: Infrastructure and Configuration
list.description: Packages and orchestrates Flask, Jupyter, Neo4j, and SMPL workflows while defining dependencies, local settings, privacy exclusions, and supervisor handoff automation.

list.name: Research and User Documentation
list.description: Documents setup, operation, SMPL assets, research framing, validation evidence, limitations, and safe project handoff.

file:app.py.name: app.py
file:app.py.summary: Hosts the Flask dashboard that coordinates dataset-backed patient selection, model prediction, SHAP explanations, what-if simulation, current and scenario SMPL twins, and the temporary Stage 4 graph.

class:app.py:PatientDataset.name: PatientDataset
class:app.py:PatientDataset.summary: Validates an active BRFSS patient table, enforces feature ranges, and exposes stable one-based patient lookup, labels, and nearby-row summaries for the dashboard.

function:app.py:get_patient_dataset.name: get_patient_dataset
function:app.py:get_patient_dataset.summary: Lazily loads and caches the default BRFSS dataset as the dashboard's active numbered patient source.

function:app.py:get_twin.name: get_twin
function:app.py:get_twin.summary: Lazily constructs and caches the model-backed Digital Twin when prediction is first requested.

function:app.py:twin_metadata.name: twin_metadata
function:app.py:twin_metadata.summary: Reads optional metadata beside a GLB twin and adds a modification-time version token, with resilient fallbacks for missing or malformed metadata.

function:app.py:digital_twin_asset.name: digital_twin_asset
function:app.py:digital_twin_asset.summary: Serves the current-patient GLB Digital Twin through a conditional Flask response or returns 404 when unavailable.

function:app.py:scenario_digital_twin_as.name: scenario_digital_twin_asset
function:app.py:scenario_digital_twin_as.summary: Serves the independently generated scenario-profile GLB Digital Twin through the dashboard.

function:app.py:refresh_smpl_twin.name: refresh_smpl_twin
function:app.py:refresh_smpl_twin.summary: Regenerates a patient-specific SMPL GLB from BMI, sex, and modeled risk, reusing matching output and falling back from direct Python export to Docker Compose.

function:app.py:index.name: index
function:app.py:index.summary: Handles dashboard GET and POST flows for importing patient data, selecting a numbered patient, predicting or simulating risk, generating twins, and assembling all template results.

file:knowledge_graph.py.name: knowledge_graph.py
file:knowledge_graph.py.summary: Implements the Stage 4 patient-centric knowledge graph: Neo4j persists only reusable definitions and model metadata, while complete patient observations, probabilities, SHAP contributions, and twin nodes are assembled in memory.

function:knowledge_graph.py:classify_bmi.name: classify_bmi
function:knowledge_graph.py:classify_bmi.summary: Maps a nonnegative BMI value to the prototype's ordered adult BMI category definitions.

function:knowledge_graph.py:_integer_cod.name: _integer_code
function:knowledge_graph.py:_integer_cod.summary: Converts a numeric categorical value to an integer and rejects non-whole codes.

function:knowledge_graph.py:decode_featu.name: decode_feature
function:knowledge_graph.py:decode_featu.summary: Decodes BRFSS feature values into dataset-grounded patient-readable states without adding clinical severity or causal interpretation.

function:knowledge_graph.py:_format_valu.name: _format_value
function:knowledge_graph.py:_format_valu.summary: Formats numeric feature values compactly while preserving fractional values when present.

function:knowledge_graph.py:_safe_id.name: _safe_id
function:knowledge_graph.py:_safe_id.summary: Normalizes display strings into lowercase hyphenated identifiers for temporary graph elements.

class:knowledge_graph.py:PatientKnowledg.name: PatientKnowledgeGraph
class:knowledge_graph.py:PatientKnowledg.summary: Lazily initializes reusable Neo4j schema and model evaluation nodes, then joins them with live profile and model outputs to return a Cytoscape-ready graph without persisting patient data.

file:stage3.py.name: stage3.py
file:stage3.py.summary: Provides the Stage 3 model-backed Digital Twin for three-class prediction, version-tolerant SHAP explanation, manual what-if comparison, and SMPL visual descriptors.

function:stage3.py:find_model_path.name: find_model_path
function:stage3.py:find_model_path.summary: Selects the first available trained model artifact from the configured candidate paths and reports all searched locations when none exists.

class:stage3.py:DiabetesDigitalTwin.name: DiabetesDigitalTwin
class:stage3.py:DiabetesDigitalTwin.summary: Wraps the trained risk model to validate profiles, predict class probabilities, rank patient-level SHAP factors, and compare baseline with manually edited scenarios.

function:stage3.py:smpl_twin_descriptor.name: smpl_twin_descriptor
function:stage3.py:smpl_twin_descriptor.summary: Derives a lightweight SMPL descriptor from BMI and high-risk probability, including body-shape coefficient, risk color band, and licensed-weight availability.

file:test_knowledge_graph.py.name: test_knowledge_graph.py
file:test_knowledge_graph.py.summary: Tests the Stage 4 graph schema, decoding boundaries, temporary patient model completeness, SHAP and probability fidelity, idempotent initialization, and Neo4j-unavailable fallback behavior.

class:test_knowledge_graph.py:FakeResult.name: FakeResult
class:test_knowledge_graph.py:FakeResult.summary: Minimal iterable Neo4j result double that supports consumption in initialization tests.

class:test_knowledge_graph.py:FakeSessio.name: FakeSession
class:test_knowledge_graph.py:FakeSessio.summary: Context-managed Neo4j session double that records Cypher calls and returns reusable attribute definitions for graph assembly tests.

class:test_knowledge_graph.py:FakeDriver.name: FakeDriver
class:test_knowledge_graph.py:FakeDriver.summary: Neo4j driver double that exposes one inspectable fake session to the graph service.

function:test_knowledge_graph.py:example.name: example_profile
function:test_knowledge_graph.py:example.summary: Builds a complete 21-feature example profile with representative BMI and categorical values.

function:test_knowledge_graph.py:example.name: example_prediction
function:test_knowledge_graph.py:example.summary: Provides a deterministic high-risk prediction fixture with all three class probabilities.

function:test_knowledge_graph.py:example.name: example_contributions
function:test_knowledge_graph.py:example.summary: Builds one SHAP contribution fixture for each of the 21 model features, including positive, negative, and neutral examples.

function:test_knowledge_graph.py:explain.name: explain
function:test_knowledge_graph.py:explain.summary: Invokes the graph service with the standard profile, prediction, SHAP, twin, and model fixtures.

class:test_knowledge_graph.py:KnowledgeG.name: KnowledgeGraphTests
class:test_knowledge_graph.py:KnowledgeG.summary: Verifies feature coverage, category decoding, complete temporary graph composition, non-causal semantics, model evidence, idempotency, and disconnected fallback behavior.

file:diabetes_risk.py.name: diabetes_risk.py
file:diabetes_risk.py.summary: Defines the shared BRFSS feature schema, risk labels, artifact paths, and validation, serialization, and model-loading helpers used throughout Stages 1-4.

function:diabetes_risk.py:load_dataset.name: load_dataset
function:diabetes_risk.py:load_dataset.summary: Loads a BRFSS CSV, enforces the 21-feature plus target schema, removes incomplete rows, and returns features with a validated three-class target.

function:diabetes_risk.py:validate_patie.name: validate_patient
function:diabetes_risk.py:validate_patie.summary: Validates that a patient frame contains exactly one complete row with the expected BRFSS features and returns it in model order as floats.

function:diabetes_risk.py:save_json.name: save_json
function:diabetes_risk.py:save_json.summary: Serializes artifact dictionaries as indented JSON while converting NumPy scalar values to native Python types.

function:diabetes_risk.py:load_model.name: load_model
function:diabetes_risk.py:load_model.summary: Loads the persisted diabetes-risk estimator from the configured joblib artifact path.

file:explain_patient.py.name: explain_patient.py
file:explain_patient.py.summary: Implements the Stage 2 command-line workflow for validating one patient, predicting risk, calculating class-specific SHAP contributions, and saving JSON, CSV, and waterfall-plot artifacts.

function:explain_patient.py:parse_args.name: parse_args
function:explain_patient.py:parse_args.summary: Defines command-line options for a patient CSV, model artifact, or example patient template.

function:explain_patient.py:main.name: main
function:explain_patient.py:main.summary: Runs single-patient inference and SHAP explanation, writes ranked contributions and a waterfall visualization, and reports the predicted risk probabilities.

file:train.py.name: train.py
file:train.py.summary: Implements Stage 1 training and evaluation for a class-balanced three-class Random Forest, producing the model, metrics, confusion matrix, ROC curves, and held-out permutation importance artifacts.

function:train.py:parse_args.name: parse_args
function:train.py:parse_args.summary: Defines training CLI options for the BRFSS dataset, split size, random seed, and forest size.

function:train.py:save_roc_curve.name: save_roc_curve
function:train.py:save_roc_curve.summary: Builds and saves one-vs-rest ROC curves with per-class AUC labels for the three risk categories.

function:train.py:main.name: main
function:train.py:main.summary: Trains the balanced Random Forest on a stratified split, evaluates overall and per-class performance, and persists model and diagnostic artifacts.

file:src/export_smpl.py.name: export_smpl.py
file:src/export_smpl.py.summary: Command-line exporter that generates a patient-shaped SMPL mesh from BMI and sex, colors it from model risk, writes GLB or OBJ output, and saves matching JSON metadata without requiring PyVista.

function:src/export_smpl.py:main.name: main
function:src/export_smpl.py:main.summary: Parses BMI, risk, gender, and output arguments, generates and colors the SMPL mesh, then exports the mesh and its patient-specific metadata.

file:src/twin_generator.py.name: twin_generator.py
file:src/twin_generator.py.summary: Provides the SMPL patient Digital Twin engine, including BMI-to-shape mapping, risk-color encoding, lazy loading of licensed legacy model weights, mesh generation, and an optional PyVista viewer.

function:src/twin_generator.py:bmi_to_be.name: bmi_to_beta0
function:src/twin_generator.py:bmi_to_be.summary: Maps patient BMI to the first SMPL shape coefficient using the project's fixed linear research mapping.

function:src/twin_generator.py:risk_to_c.name: risk_to_color
function:src/twin_generator.py:risk_to_c.summary: Converts a risk percentage into green, orange, or red presentation colors using explicit threshold bands.

class:src/twin_generator.py:TwinGenerato.name: TwinGenerator
class:src/twin_generator.py:TwinGenerato.summary: Loads and caches the sex-specific licensed SMPL model, runs CPU mesh generation from patient BMI, and optionally wraps the result as a risk-colored PyVista mesh.

function:src/twin_generator.py:display_d.name: display_demo
function:src/twin_generator.py:display_d.summary: Generates a sample risk-colored patient mesh and displays it interactively in a PyVista window for local inspection.

file:static/js/knowledge_graph.js.name: knowledge_graph.js
file:static/js/knowledge_graph.js.summary: Initializes the patient-centric Cytoscape knowledge graph, styles clinical-observation and model-evidence node groups, and supports node inspection, filtering, reset, responsive relayout, and accessible fallback behavior.

file:static/style.css.name: style.css
file:static/style.css.summary: Defines the responsive visual system for patient selection, risk results, SHAP factors, Stage 4 graph inspection, and current-versus-scenario 3D twin comparison cards.

file:templates/index.html.name: index.html
file:templates/index.html.summary: Primary Flask/Jinja dashboard template joining patient import and selection with Stages 1-4 outputs: probabilities, SHAP evidence, an interactive knowledge graph, current SMPL twin, and manual scenario comparison.
